statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent and need to be correlated with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances to evaluate for arrhythmias
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated
The denial reason code is CO-22
The current CO-22 denial concerns coordination of benefits rather than medical necessity
